name: Cave
description: A damp underground cavern. Shadows cling to the walls and echoes carry far.

name: Plains
description: Open grasslands with clear skies and little cover.

name: Desert
description: Scorching sands stretch in every direction under a relentless sun.

name: Swamp
description: A murky bog of thick mud and choking mist.

name: Ancient Ruins
description: Crumbling stone structures humming with residual arcane energy.

name: Volcanic
description: Rivers of molten rock wind between jagged obsidian spires.

name: Forest
description: Dense woodland where shadows blur and underbrush conceals movement.

name: Graveyard
description: Rows of crumbling headstones under a moonless sky. The air reeks of old death.

name: Misty Mountains
description: Jagged peaks shrouded in cold fog. Visibility is poor and the air bites with chill.

name: Haunted Manor
description: A decaying estate crackling with dark energy. Every shadow seems to breathe.

name: Crypt
description: A sealed underground tomb. The silence is absolute and the darkness total.

name: Open Sky
description: A vast cliff-top arena open to the winds. Aerial creatures thrive here.

name: Marshlands
description: Waterlogged flats choked with reeds. The ground shifts underfoot and poisons linger.
